methodology.title: About this estimate
methodology.heatStress: Heat stress (UTCI/WBGT) is calculated from real forecast temperature, humidity, wind, and solar radiation using published thermal-comfort formulas.
methodology.mortality: Heat-mortality risk is modeled from a published dose-response curve linking heat stress to excess deaths. It is a citywide estimate - ward-level mortality figures don't exist and aren't shown.
methodology.confidence: Every estimate is shown with its real uncertainty range. A range reflects genuine statistical uncertainty, not imprecision in the app.
methodology.wardScope: Age and occupation risk breakdowns come from the best available published studies, which are citywide or national - not ward-specific.
methodology.sourceAllCause: All-cause mortality share: Wei et al. 2021
methodology.sourceHeatstroke: Heatstroke-classified deaths: Guin et al. 2025 (India-wide NCRB records)
methodology.sourceOccupational: Outdoor vs. indoor worker risk: Venugopal et al. 2021 (Tamil Nadu)
methodology.sourceEms: Emergency response patterns: Ranadive et al. 2021 (Ahmedabad ambulance service)

whatsapp.enableFirst: Save your WhatsApp opt-in to receive automatic alerts.

whatsapp.corporateDescription: Automatic heat-action checklists for your institution, in your saved language. Messages use this account’s contact phone.
